 PORTLAND, Ore — Portland police are asking the public to watch for 60-year-old Yuriy Shevyakov, who is missing from the Powellhurst-Gilbert neighborhood and may need medication.
 Shevyakov left his home in the 12100 block of Southeast Holgate Boulevard at about 6 p.m. Friday, Oct. 23. He has not returned, and efforts to find him have been unsuccessful, police said.
 He is described as a white man, 5 feet 7 inches tall and weighing about 150 pounds. He was last seen wearing a beige cap, a blue checkered shirt, a blue suit jacket, black pants and black shoes. Shevyakov primarily speaks Russian and has limited English. He has no phone or money but is familiar with the transit system.
 Anyone who sees Shevyakov should call 911. Anyone with non-urgent information can email the Portland Police Missing Persons Unit at missing@police.portlandoregon.gov and reference case No. 26-309433.
